owner: integration repository (not the frozen sources/ondevice_ai snapshot)
rationale: Weights follow current evidence maturity, not the legacy V4 0.35/0.35/0.15/0.15 split.
CO2 is the only continuously trustworthy live scalar and is the primary enclosed-space environmental hazard, so it shares the largest weight with thermal.
CO2 occupancy/localization is out of this formula. The C-B6 occupancy head has risk_semantic NONE and does not score.

warning_ppm 1500 is the Indoor Air Quality Control Act enforcement-rule Table 2 footnote exception for mechanically ventilated spaces where natural ventilation is impossible. Table 2 default 1000 ppm is for naturally ventilated public facilities and is not the live enclosed-space trip; field idle is about 1184 ppm.

danger_ppm 2500 is a Satish 2012 chamber magnitude used only as a WARNING floor so a single gas channel cannot scream DANGER while person-state evidence is calm. immediate_danger_ppm 5000 matches the OSHA PEL / NIOSH REL / ACGIH TLV 8-hour TWA number, used here as a team instantaneous emergency, not a certified occupational average. Industrial adequate-air CO2 is 1.5 percent (15000 ppm) under Occupational Safety and Health Standards Article 618.

baseline_delta_warning_ppm 700 follows ASHRAE 62.1 informative indoor-minus-outdoor bioeffluent guidance. After a 180 s source-clock median lock, plus-only delta raises co2_relative_warning. Occupancy C-B6 stays risk_semantic NONE.
The active public-SDT FP32 thermal model contributes bounded HUMAN_FALL_PROXY risk and cannot assert a real fall or emergency.
mmWave neural output is OBSERVE_ONLY. Unverified APNEA-proxy may raise WARNING after persistence; only hardware-verified apnea is DANGER.
PIR is corroborating only and is unavailable, not zero, when presence is unconfirmed.
A weighted sum alone dilutes a single severe hazard, so per-signal escalation floors are applied on top of the score.
Reporting NORMAL from a small fraction of the sensor set is unsafe, so an evidence-sufficiency gate emits INDETERMINATE instead.
formula: R = 100 * sum(w_i * s_i for available i) / sum(w_i for available i); level = max(level(R), escalation_floors)

ai_acceptance.comment: A 3-class thermal head near uniform output is not a decision; it is refused instead of scored.

mmwave.neural_trust_reason: MMWAVE_M_N9_FULL_INT8_V1 is DEVICE_VALIDATED: NO / PI_SMOKE: NOT_PERFORMED, was trained on 337 public windows with mr60_used_for_calibration false, and on the committed 20260817 capture emits high-confidence APNEA-proxy over a signal carrying 82% of its power in the respiration band with a clean 20 rpm peak. Until a device smoke or retrain lands, the neural class is recorded but does not score. Set TRUSTED only after DEVICE_VALIDATED becomes true.
